changeSet.comment: Whether an estate's allocation-letter approval (093/094) still stands: its newest approval or withdrawal is an approval, and every version it recorded is still the current one. The same rule LetterApprovalService derives in Java; ReservationCheckoutUnderRlsIT keeps the two in step. SECURITY DEFINER because the public marketplace views call it with no tenant scope, and every table it reads is RLS-policied. Boolean only, hardened like 043/047/054.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION landvault_estate_letter_approved(p_estate uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$ WITH e AS ( SELECT id, tenant_id, branch_id, fees_declared_at, fees_version FROM estates WHERE id = p_estate AND deleted = false ), branch_template AS ( SELECT max(r.template_version) AS version FROM letter_template_reviews r, e WHERE e.branch_id IS NOT NULL AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.branch_id = e.branch_id AND r.decision = 'APPROVED' ), company_template AS ( SELECT max(r.template_version) AS version FROM letter_template_reviews r, e WHERE r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.branch_id IS NULL AND r.decision = 'APPROVED' ), cur AS ( SELECT (SELECT max(r.terms_version) FROM estate_letter_terms_reviews r WHERE r.estate_id = e.id AND r.decision = 'APPROVED') AS terms_version, coalesce((SELECT l.version FROM letterheads l WHERE l.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND l.branch_id IS NULL AND l.deleted = false), 0) AS company_letterhead_version, CASE WHEN e.branch_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE coalesce((SELECT l.version FROM letterheads l WHERE l.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND l.branch_id = e.branch_id AND l.deleted = false), 0) END AS branch_letterhead_version, CASE WHEN e.fees_declared_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.fees_version END AS fees_version, (SELECT max(rt.version) FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false) AS refund_terms_version, (SELECT max(dt.version) FROM estate_default_terms dt WHERE dt.estate_id = e.id AND dt.deleted = false) AS default_terms_version, CASE WHEN (SELECT version FROM branch_template) IS NOT NULL THEN 'branch' WHEN (SELECT version FROM company_template) IS NOT NULL THEN 'company' ELSE 'default' END AS template_source, coalesce((SELECT version FROM branch_template), (SELECT version FROM company_template)) AS template_version FROM e ), latest AS ( SELECT * FROM estate_letter_approvals WHERE estate_id = p_estate ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT coalesce(( SELECT a.action = 'APPROVED' AND a.terms_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.terms_version AND a.company_letterhead_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.company_letterhead_version AND a.branch_letterhead_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.branch_letterhead_version AND a.fees_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.fees_version AND a.refund_terms_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.refund_terms_version AND a.default_terms_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.default_terms_version AND a.template_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.template_source AND a.template_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.template_version FROM latest a, cur c), false) $$; REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_estate_letter_approved(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION landvault_estate_letter_approved(uuid) TO ${appDbUsername};

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW marketplace_estate_eligibility WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT e.id AS estate_id, e.published AS published, (o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED') AS tenant_verified, o.marketplace_publishing AS tenant_entitled, (o.status = 'ACTIVE') AS tenant_active, -- CASE short-circuits, so the conflict function — the only -- expensive term — runs last, and only for estates that -- already pass every cheap condition. CASE WHEN e.published AND o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED' AND o.marketplace_publishing AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (e.fees_declared_at IS NOT NULL OR e.fees_declaration_exempt) AND (e.fees_declaration_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false)) AND e.footprint IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plots p WHERE p.estate_id = e.id AND p.deleted = false) AND (e.photo_requirement_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_photos ph WHERE ph.estate_id = e.id AND ph.deleted = false)) AND landvault_estate_letter_approved(e.id) THEN (SELECT s.blocking_count FROM landvault_estate_conflict_summary(e.id) s) = 0 ELSE false END AS eligible, -- Declaring an EMPTY schedule counts: an estate with no -- extra charges may list, but by saying so. Silence does -- not, and the two are different facts. (e.fees_declared_at IS NOT NULL OR e.fees_declaration_exempt) AS fees_declared, -- RF-4: a developer who will not state what a buyer gets -- back does not get a listing. Its own boolean beside the -- others so the publish endpoint can name which one failed. (e.fees_declaration_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false)) AS refund_terms_declared, -- BG-1: an estate with no boundary is invisible to conflict -- detection, so listing without one would be a way around -- it. No exemption for estates already published: an -- exempt boundary-less listing is exactly the hole. (e.footprint IS NOT NULL) AS has_boundary, -- An estate with nothing to sell is not a listing. ANY live -- plot counts, whatever its status: requiring an AVAILABLE -- one would pull a sold-out estate off the marketplace and -- make one flicker during checkout holds, revealing exactly -- the sales velocity marketplace_plots collapses statuses to -- hide. EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plots p WHERE p.estate_id = e.id AND p.deleted = false) AS has_plots, -- A buyer should see what they are buying into. Estates -- already published when this shipped are exempt and report -- true, like fees_declared. (e.photo_requirement_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_photos ph WHERE ph.estate_id = e.id AND ph.deleted = false)) AS has_photo, -- No sale without its allocation letter: finance can't verify a -- purchase on an estate whose letter isn't approved, so it must -- not be for sale either. No exemption for live estates — a -- buyer could otherwise pay for a plot nobody can allocate. landvault_estate_letter_approved(e.id) AS letter_approved FROM estates e JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.tenant_id AND o.deleted = false WHERE e.deleted = false;

CREATE SEQUENCE allocation_letter_number_seq; GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE allocation_letter_number_seq TO ${appDbUsername};
CREATE TABLE allocation_letters ( id uuid NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, created_by varchar(255),
number varchar(32) NOT NULL, verification_code varchar(16) NOT NULL, transaction_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), buyer_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), seller_tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id), branch_id uuid REFERENCES branches (id), estate_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES estates (id), plot_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plots (id), issued_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, issued_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
company_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, company_rc_number varchar(64), company_address varchar(512), company_phone varchar(64), company_email varchar(255), company_website varchar(255), logo_file_id uuid REFERENCES stored_files (id), signature_file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES stored_files (id), seal_file_id uuid REFERENCES stored_files (id), signatory_name varchar(120) NOT NULL, signatory_title varchar(120) NOT NULL,
buyer_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, buyer_lines text[] NOT NULL, salutation varchar(300) NOT NULL, estate_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, estate_location varchar(512), plot_label varchar(255) NOT NULL, opening text NOT NULL, clauses text[] NOT NULL, closing text, sign_off varchar(80) NOT NULL,
approval_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES estate_letter_approvals (id), terms_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES estate_letter_terms (id), terms_version integer NOT NULL, template_source varchar(10) NOT NULL, template_version integer, company_letterhead_version integer NOT NULL, branch_letterhead_version integer, fees_version integer, refund_terms_version integer, default_terms_version integer,
CONSTRAINT uq_allocation_letters_number UNIQUE (number), CONSTRAINT uq_allocation_letters_verification_code UNIQUE (verification_code), CONSTRAINT uq_allocation_letters_transaction UNIQUE (transaction_id), CONSTRAINT chk_allocation_letters_verification_code CHECK (verification_code ~ '^[0-9A-F]{16}$'), CONSTRAINT chk_allocation_letters_template_source CHECK (template_source IN ('default', 'company', 'branch')) ); CREATE INDEX idx_allocation_letters_buyer ON allocation_letters (buyer_user_id, issued_at DESC); REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON allocation_letters FROM ${appDbUsername}; COMMENT ON TABLE allocation_letters IS 'Allocation letters HomeTrue issued when finance verified a sale: a copy of everything printed, never changed. See AGENTS.md, "Documents: the allocation letter".';
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE allocation_letters; DROP SEQUENCE allocation_letter_number_seq;
